content.summary: Clean v0. Clear separation between HTTP, storage and codegen; validation at the edge; redirects are analytics-safe. Test coverage matches the acceptance criteria one-to-one.

findings.issue: No rate limiting on POST /api/links; an open create endpoint can be used to mint phishing links at volume.
findings.recommendation: Track as v1 item alongside durable storage (per-IP limiter, e.g. Bucket4j).

findings.issue: validateUrl accepts private-network and localhost targets.
findings.recommendation: Add a private-IP / localhost guard before any server-side fetching of targets is introduced.

findings.issue: The controller instantiates its own LinkStore instead of receiving a bean.
findings.recommendation: Make LinkStore a @Bean once a second adapter exists.

findings.issue: Contract tests only run against the in-memory adapter.
findings.recommendation: Turn LinkStoreTest into an abstract contract when a JDBC adapter lands.

policySummary: dependency-change-requires-approval raised on T1 (pom.xml) and approved
tests-accompany-source waived on T4 because the stage is verified green against the T2 acceptance suite
